title: Tech Note: 4D Ajax Framework: Working with DCS Views
author: Tom Fitch, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D Ajax Framework (4DAF) Developer Created Selections (DCS) Views

historical_commentary.text: This note documents Developer Created Selections (DCS) Views, a 4D Ajax Framework feature letting developers programmatically define grid-style Views backed by arbitrary array-populated data (not necessarily 4D table records) via four developer hooks for view creation, selection/population, record save, and record delete. This array-driven, hook-based pattern for surfacing arbitrary or composite data sources through a UI grid is a reasonable architectural idea in the abstract, but its concrete implementation is entirely dependent on the discontinued 4D Ajax Framework and 4D Web 2.0 Pack, making the note's specific APIs non-functional in any current 4D product.
related_updates: 4D Web 2.0 Pack and the 4D Ajax Framework, including DCS Views and the DAX_DevHook_DCS_* developer hooks, have been discontinued
Modern 4D applications surface arbitrary/composite data sources in UI list/grid objects using current list-box and collection/entity-selection based approaches rather than DCS Views
The daxipedia.4d.com wiki referenced for further documentation is no longer a current 4D resource
